items.headline: Mizuho Upgrades Albemarle to Outperform from Neutral
items.snippet: Mizuho upgraded Albemarle (NYSE:ALB) from Neutral to Outperform on Oct 14, 2026. Barclays initiated at Equal-Weight Oct 13; Argus Buy Oct 7; UBS Buy Oct 5.

items.headline: Albemarle upgraded to Outperform from Neutral at Mizuho

items.headline: Bear of the Day: Albemarle Corporation (ALB)
items.snippet: Zacks Rank #5 (Strong Sell): ALB earnings outlook dropped 13% for Q3 and 36% for Q4 since the Q2 release; stock down 55% over five years.

items.headline: Albemarle price target lowered to $135 from $230 at Argus
items.snippet: Argus lowered PT to $135 from $230, keeps Buy. Lithium up ~67% y/y but well below highs; supply/demand poised to improve into 2027.

items.headline: Albemarle price target lowered to $175 from $200 at BMO Capital
items.snippet: BMO lowers PT to $175 from $200, keeps Outperform, citing recent spot lithium price weakness; group viewed as oversold.

items.headline: Albemarle Q2 2026 Earnings Call Transcript
items.snippet: Tight lithium market; demand up 45% through May driven by stationary storage; 2026 outlook maintained at high end of scenario ranges.
